description: Open promotion watch windows or feed case measurements; roll back immediately on failed quality gates or after an expensive cost window. Rollback failures remain watching and are returned as data with exit code 0.

op.description: Open appends a window; feed adds a sample to every watching window.

watch.description: Absolute path to the watch JSON document. Open creates it when missing; feed treats a missing file as no windows.

target.description: Open: definition path relative to defs.

defs.description: Open: absolute live definition root, retained for rollback.

metric.description: Open: JSON pointer into measure.cost, for example /token/in.

window.description: Open: positive number of cases in the cost window.

tolerance.description: Open: non-negative allowed relative increase, for example 0.10.

case.description: Feed: case identifier stored in each sample.

measure.description: Feed: complete measure result including cost, positive size_bytes and check.pass.
